answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 38027 Country: India Title: Since some months there is hard water problem in my home, bore well is getting dried Question: Since some months there is hard water problem in my home, bore well is getting dried. Please suggest me dua to have sufficient water in bore well? Answer ID: 38027 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 795/667/B=1433) Keep on reading istighfar extensively: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم و اتوب اليه . Also recite the following verses from Surah Nuh: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّاراً يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاء عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَاراً. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
